intent: Implement exact post-boot SADHANA campaign authority binding over the canonical live AgentPool, TaskBoard metadata, and file-backed execution leases. One explicit self-digested manifest binds the frozen bootstrap mission and every exact goal task to one stable roster name, current AgentState ID, deterministic relative workspace, canonical allowed files, stable MissionDispatchRequest, zero-dollar authority, and expiry no later than the exact campaign end. Reconciliation is two-phase, resumable, and fails closed on foreign partials; governed dispatch revalidates exact campaign lease constraints and rejects executor identity substitution.

commit.message: feat(control): bind exact SADHANA campaign authority

interface_mismatches: Bootstrap seed readiness fields are immutable provenance and remain false/authority_unbound after binding; only the additive typed campaign authority envelope plus exact current lease may authorize dispatch.
AgentState IDs are boot-local while the authority manifest names stable roster seats, requiring exact-one live name resolution and an idempotent principal refresh on every boot.

TaskBoard metadata and execution-lease files are separate write domains, so all task/roster/partial-state validation must finish before the first write and deterministic lease-first reconciliation must recover only its own exact partials.

The shared lease validator permits action supersets and warns on spend, while this campaign must fail closed unless actions, paths, zero-dollar budget, stable correlation, exact campaign identity, and end-bounded expiry all match.
GovernedMissionDispatcher validates owner mission/task/dispatch identity but historically did not bind the returned owner agent ID to the authenticated principal.
honest_blockers: This packet binds only an already-instantiated post-init roster; it does not create AgentConfigs, update model/provider routes, provision credentials, or certify that the current crew uses the desired model catalog.

The existing campaign writer serializes this reconciliation locally, but TaskBoard plus file leases have no cross-process transaction and OrchestratorMissionAdapter makes no fleet-wide exactly-once claim.
An exact live AgentState at bind time and a valid lease prove scoped authority only, not later process liveness, useful model output, independent acceptance, promotion, merge, or publication.
A busy principal can be bound but must remain undispatchable; another idle agent can never substitute.
The separately sealed dharmagraph packet owns the exact Orchestrator selection seam; this packet does not edit that sibling surface.
No manifest is generated automatically. Operators must supply one exact self-digested authority manifest whose task IDs and contracts match the bootstrapped campaign.
session_entry.rollback: Stop the supervisor and revert this implementation commit. Remove only lease files whose deterministic IDs are recorded in the task authority envelopes if operational cleanup is desired; task seed metadata remains intact and queued work is preserved. No schema migration, model-account mutation, transport topology, provider credential, promotion, merge, deployment, or external publication is introduced.
